messages:
maria: Quick check — cutover window is 03:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow. Final asks before freeze:
- pin model to rtx-prod:v3.2.1
- disable DB migrations during window
- ensure canary at 1% and traffic gates in place

sam: Got it. I'll pin the model and push the canary config. Deploy-bot will kick at 03:05.

leah: Freeze reminder: 02:00-05:00 UTC. No infra or schema changes. Only safety/rollback ops allowed during window. :lock:

deploy-bot: upcoming: canary rollout scheduled for 03:05 UTC -> target: dedicated-gpu-pool-2 (1% traffic)

ben: Smoke ETA ~5m after canary finishes ramp. Abort criteria: error rate >5% or P95 latency >2s. If hit, run rollback immediately.

maria: Rollback playbook (short):
```
# revert canary and pin previous tag
deployctl rollback --service inference --to-tag v3.2.0
deployctl pin --service inference --tag v3.2.0 --duration 60m
# notify pager and post status in #incidents\``` 

oncall-daphne: I'll be on watch for alerts and traces. If I see cascade, I'll trigger rollback and DM infra leads.

sam: Also enabling traffic gating: 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 30m with 3m burn windows and automatic hold on alerts. Config snippet pushed to deploy repo.

maria: Confirm release notes posted to #announcements? We need a line about performance tweaks and the pinned model version.

leah: Posted and linked to changelog: https://internal.redwood/changelog/rel-3.2.1 :white_check_mark:

ben: Canary runtime is set to dedicated-gpu-pool-2 (confirmed). Not touching shared pool.

maria: Final go/no-go at 02:50 UTC in this thread. If no objections, we proceed with preflight and canary.

sam: +1

leah: +1

ben: +1

oncall-daphne: +1

maria: OK starting preflight checks now. I'll post smoke results in ~10m. If anything looks off, call abort and we'll fall back to v3.2.0. :thumbsup:
